DC Button

Purpose:
The DC button opens the DayZ client DataCache folder. DC means DataCache.

When To Use It:
Use this button when DayZ shows strange visual problems, missing textures, broken fog, bright pink or magenta screen effects, or other client-side rendering problems after joining a LAN server.

What It Opens:
The DC button opens this folder inside LAN Launcher:
%LOCALAPPDATA%\DayZ\DataCache

The important file in this folder is:
cache.ch

How To Use It:
1. Click the DC button.
2. LAN Launcher will show the DayZ DataCache folder in the white display window.
3. Click the cache.ch file.
4. LAN Launcher will announce, "You may now click the DELETE button."
5. Click DELETE.
6. The cache.ch file will be moved to the Recycle Bin.
7. Launch DayZ again. DayZ will automatically rebuild a fresh cache.ch file.

Safety Notes:
LAN Launcher only allows the cache.ch file to be deleted from this DataCache view. This helps protect the user from deleting unrelated files by mistake.

This button does not uninstall DayZ, does not uninstall DayZServer, and does not delete any server map. It only helps clear the DayZ client cache when visual/rendering problems appear.
